description: This file defines interfaces, configuration objects, and utility functions for managing agent form fields and agent data in a software project. It includes form configuration schemas, default value generation, data building, and parsing functions related to agent settings.

methods.name: getDefaultFormValues
methods.description: Generates default form values based on the configuration schema.

methods.name: buildAgentDataFromForm
methods.description: Constructs agent data object from form input values, optionally merging with existing agent data.

methods.name: parseAgentForForm
methods.description: Parses agent data into form-compatible values for editing or viewing.
